---
name: Replication or negative result
about: Report reproduction, disagreement, failure, insufficient evidence or a blocker.
title: "[replication] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Original claim

Link its immutable source, configuration and evaluation period. Do not just quote a
headline return.

## What was executed

Provide exact commands, environment, permitted input identities and differences from
the original. Distinguish a record inspection from a fresh backtest.

## Outcome

Reproduced / discrepancy / negative / inconclusive / blocked. Compare model and
baseline using compatible units and periods. Include failures and missing evidence.

## Limits and next verification

Is this independent replication or a rerun of the same code? What remains unknown?
Attach only public-safe aggregates and synthetic/permitted fixtures, never secrets.
